rationale: The assistant stopped use at once, said not to keep resetting, tied the 10-20 min trip on the 65C programme to the heating phase, and sent the customer to an engineer for the element. Its first reply asked a timing question the customer had already half-answered, which was a minor miss. The element is presented as the likely cause, not confirmed, and no part was recommended.
